name: @hl-bos/bti-cycle
description: BTI V1 — one complete transformation cycle, Customer Goal → Measurement Contract, implementing the approved BTI constitution (Reasoning Ledger, Confidence State Machine, Evidence Appetite, Recommendation Stability, Measurement Contract). Deterministic and DB-agnostic: it invents no data, caps its own confidence honestly, and refuses to over-claim. Persistence and UI are out of scope for this slice.
